expressions:
Use case: illustration-story. Production animation SPRITESHEET as a single image, 6 columns x 4 rows, EXACT uniform cells. 1536x1024 pixels preferred, each cell 256x256. Use bottom four portrait expressions in attached reference image as character identity/style source. ONLY bust portraits: orange hamster, same circular black sunglasses, cream cheeks, red Hawaiian shirt with cream flowers. Crisp detailed pixel-like outline, source style, NOT smooth vector. Each row is 6 sequential frames of ONE animation, identical identity, framing, scale and shoulder baseline across frames. Art completely contained in each cell with 12% margin. Do not show legs.
Row1 HAPPY: gentle giggle, mouth changes from smile to open chuckle to smile, cheeks rise, tiny head tilt progressing across frames, shoulders gently bounce.
Row2 CALM: relaxed closed smile, subtle breathing, 1-2 pixel head tilt then back, mouth mostly closed, NO sparkles.
Row3 SLEEPY: slow nod down then up, mouth changes to tiny yawn and closed, small brown 'Z' marks drift upward and change across frames.
Row4 EXCITED: wide grin, mouth opens a little more and relaxes, ears perk, small gold sparkles twinkle around head changing positions/sizes between frames.
Each row must have SIX distinct frames, no extra rows or columns, no merged subjects. First and last frames similar for loop. Keep sunglasses unchanged. No labels, frames, shadows, text captions or decorative headers.
BACKGROUND is only perfectly uniform solid saturated MAGENTA #FF00FF, for downstream chroma-key extraction to real alpha. NO checkerboard, NO paper, NO gradients. No magenta in foreground. This is an intermediate image to be assembled into four transparent animated GIFs and PNG sprite strips.
